characterList.description: A man using a metal detector on the beach, wearing a camouflage jacket, blue jeans, white sneakers, a black baseball cap, and gloves. He carries a yellow pouch with 'The Gold Digger' written on it.

content_metadata.description: A man's day of treasure hunting on the beach using a metal detector, showcasing his finds and experiences.

Denny and I head for the button patch today.  Cold day, lots of sunshine and not much wind.

Got one cave report from deep action – good results.

Nitro, wheaties and kewl brass tag was the best of it for me.

Denny found the ammo pile like I had on Sunday – some kewl tickets and much more clad that me.

Knife gig tomorrow – see you

Good luck to everyone.
